title: Keep an entity’s evidence detail
responsibility: Reduces revision and record details to one entity while preserving evidence sides and opaque source-tree identity without cache filenames.

inputs.name: recordedProjection.evidence
inputs.description: The entity-scoped evidence whose coverage determines which scenario states to retain.

inputs.name: recordedProjection.entityId
inputs.description: The exact unit identity to retain in registry details, reasons, failures, measurements, budgets and change summaries.

outputs.name: recordedProjection
outputs.description: Entity-scoped sides preserve captures, coverage, tests, judging records and the opaque source-tree hash needed to re-derive identical-tree screenshots. Unrelated units, graph edges, changed files, uncertainty lists and cache filenames are excluded. A side without detail stays unchanged. The input is not mutated.
